name: Tyzon Swann
strengths: Swann fires a sudden first step into the B-gap — pads stay low and he shoots the A/B seams before the guard can reset.
Swann chases from the backside and finishes to the sideline when the run stretches, then anchors the point with length when the double comes.
Swann’s get-off and functional strength already look SEC-ready for a 6-3.5 / 265 interior.
weaknesses: Swann still needs hand-counter polish when OL sit on his first move and climb into doubles.
comparison: Swann comps to Christian Wilkins — 6-3 disruptive DL with first-step quickness and functional strength to occupy gaps and push the pocket.
projection: Swann projects as a Year 2 SEC starter on the interior (rotation snaps Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC defensive lineman — the disruptive 3-tech who can occupy gaps and push the pocket every down.
schemeFit: Swann fits White’s odd front as a disruptive interior who can two-gap or penetrate depending on call.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-verified 2026-08-10 from On3 profile Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Tyzon Swann is a 4-star / five-star-trait DL · listed 6-3.5 / 265 · Henry E. Lackey (Head, MD) · open-board Florida target with Chatman offer and daily staff contact.
angle: Lead with Lackey MD soph Hudl first-step; 5-star DL priority.
insiderNotes: Swann is a disruptive interior with first-step quickness for a 265-pound frame, functional strength to hold the point, and pursuit that finishes to the sideline. Wins with get-off and B-gap penetration — a 3-tech style disruptor with five-star traits.
